units: <cite ref="Shabbat 113b:1">Sabb. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>הִילּוּכְךָ של שבת</he> thy way of walking on the Sabbath.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:10">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>ה׳ מעים כדרך וכ׳</he> (not <he>בדרך</he>) natural movement of the bowels (<cite ref="Berakhot 57b:17">Ber. 57ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="U01391"><he>שלשול</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: walking (lengthwise and breadthwise) through a field, as a form of taking possession.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 100a:6">B. Bath. 100ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:6">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ</cite>
<cite ref="Zevachim 15b:6">Ib. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ שצריך להלך</he> (<cite ref="L00471"><he>לילך</he></cite>) a carrying necessary for the purpose.
